coverage_note: The reviewed first 1000 cards are preserved. The other paid 9000 Gemini cards are re-authored locally, and the remaining characters are completed locally, using canonical visual component glosses and validation for every card. Extra learner-gap glyphs and Japanese compatibility forms are added explicitly when frequency/name/JPDB heuristics showed useful exact glyphs outside the original component-gloss and taxonomy target set.
